name: Operational dashboard
category: Dense operational board, queue, or internal tool
summary: A compact board for status, filters, and tables. Clarity outranks ornament. Figures are fictional.

fidelity.notes: Whisper is the default so tables and filters stay quiet. Costume may be switched on; it must not hide rows or labels.

required.purpose: Search, status, and a binary control

layouts: One compact bar, a metric row, filters, then tabbed tables.
Do not use a full-viewport .ew-hero. There is no table component; use a native table.

responsive.behavior: Metrics wrap. Filters wrap. Tables scroll inside a region instead of widening the page.

priorities: Display faces stay off controls and table cells.

spacing.priority: 8 to 12 pixel gaps. Row padding stays compact in page CSS, not a new global density token.

interactions: Search and status filter the rows.
The switch explains that the sample clock is frozen.
accessibility: Tables have captions and column headers.
Filter changes update a live count.
Do not rely on color for status; include a text status.

use: Era chrome on cards, tabs, and controls.
A single warning alert for the fictional data.

eraDeviations.note: Switching era changes control geometry and type. Do not add .ew-hero. If costume ornament competes with the table, drop the page to standard or whisper.

customization: Metric labels, columns, and sample rows.
Era switch stays on the root.
Page CSS may tighten row padding; do not invent a global density attribute unless measurement shows ornament hiding data.
